_doc: Opening Markdown code fences glued to the end of a prose line without a newline (e.g. `cleanly!```mermaid`) are split onto their own line before block parsing, while inline code spans, prose mentioning backticks, and lines inside open code fences stay untouched. Implementations: orb/src/codeFences.ts (normalizeGluedFences / splitGluedFence), iOS OrbCodeFences, Android OrbCodeFences.
